why: Phase 1 main menu: the server spawns the character when the player presses PLAY (CharacterService.SpawnPlayer).

Vehicle stability: fixed 240 Hz physics stepping (Enum.PhysicsSteppingMethod.Fixed = 1). With adaptive stepping, fast assemblies with stiff springs/servos and wheel impacts may be stepped less often. Verify in Studio: Workspace > PhysicsSteppingMethod = Fixed.
